051000:002.t016:
DAD WENT TO
INVESTIGATE.
I ASKED TO GO.
HE SAID NO.
051000:002.t022:
I'M EIGHTEEN!
HE STILL
TREATS ME AS
A CHILD!

051000:003.t010:
DAD WENT WITH
DR. PENROSE TO
SAXEN CANYON
TO STUDY IT

051000:004.t003:
WYURIA AND
ZOLIAS ARE
AT WAR NOW.
DARK TIMES.

051000:006.t003:
HOM IS GREENER
NOW, BUT WASTE
POLLUTES THE
HAMACK AREA.
051000:006.t006:
MUTANT GIGI
RUN WILD AT
THE DUST WASTE
DISPOSAL SITE.

051000:008.t004:
STAY IN TOWN!
THE WASTELAND
IS FULL OF
CANYON BUGS.

051000:011.t012:
BUT THERE ARE
SO MANY GIGI
IN SAXEN
CANYON...
051000:011.t034:
I TOOK TWO
FROM DAD. FOR
PROTECTION.

051000:012.t004:
YOU COWARD!
SOME MAN
YOU ARE!

051000:013.t000:
SO, YOU WANT
TO GO NOW?

051000:014.t001:
YOU BOTH LOOK
TIRED. COME
OVER HERE AND
HAVE A REST.

051000:015.t000:
YOU TWO ARE
ACTING ODD.
GOING TO SEE
THE METEOR?!

051000:018.t000:
IT FELL IN THE
NORTH CANYON.
I'VE NEVER
SEEN THE LIKE!

051000:021.t000:
YOUR MOM LEFT
TOWN IN A DAZE
AS IF SHE WERE
POSSESSED.

051000:024.t001:
YOUR BAGS ARE
FULL. MAKE
SOME ROOM.

051000:025.t000:
WHERE WERE
YOU?! THE GIRL
AT THE COUNTER
WAS FURIOUS!

051000:026.t000:
ASK AT THE
COUNTER
ABOUT WORK.

051000:028.t009:
HOW CREEPY!
GET RID OF IT,
051000:028.t003:
WHY IS THERE
A DEAD GIGI
HERE?
